// diagnostic

E1362

The inline `package { … }` declaration is malformed or missing its closing brace.

What

The inline `package { … }` declaration is malformed or missing its closing brace.

Why

The contextual carrier must have one balanced block before its body can be passed to the canonical Package parser.

Fix

Close the block and fix its structure, then let the Package field diagnostic identify any invalid field.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1362: tests/ui/inline_package_malformed.stderr.

Error [E1362]: The inline `package { … }` declaration is malformed or missing its closing brace.
  --> tests/ui/inline_package_malformed.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | package { name: "demo"
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The contextual carrier must have one balanced block before its body can be passed to the canonical Package parser.
 Fix: Close the block and fix its structure, then let the Package field diagnostic identify any invalid field.
